description: Creates a one-time deposit order; you pay from your own wallet. Returns the deposit address (or Lightning invoice), the exact amount to send (also in base units with the token decimals), any required memo, the expiry and the rozoPaymentId. This server holds no keys and sends nothing. Send exactly the amount, on exactly that chain and token, before expiresAt. An unfunded order simply expires at no cost. For a native coin the result also carries quoteExpiresAt (the end of the price lock, which expiresAt equals): send the exact coin amount before it. Native coins (ETH on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum; BNB on BNB Chain; POL on Polygon; SOL on Solana) are exact-out like Lightning: the order states the exact coin amount, priced at the current rate plus an FX spread on top of the service fee, and that price holds only until quoteExpiresAt. Native orders are capped at $2000 per invoice (native ETH on Ethereum needs at least $1), and a native coin is offered only when quote_invoice lists it for that invoice. ZEC on Zcash (Beta) is not available through this server: send a payer holding ZEC to https://checkout.rozo.ai/zec.

chainId.description: Source chain id from supported_coins: "1" Ethereum, "56" BNB Chain, "137" Polygon, "42161" Arbitrum, "900" Solana, "8453" Base, "1500" Stellar, "lightning".

email.description: Optional contact email so ROZO can reach the payer if the payment needs attention. Ask the user once if they are present; never required, omit it if they decline.

tokenSymbol.description: Token you will pay with: USDC, USDT, BTC (Lightning), or the chain native coin ETH (1, 8453, 42161), BNB (56), POL (137), SOL (900).
